What does the DeFi agent do?

It runs the project's own PancakeSwap V{n}position by itself, in the CAKE/BNB {n} pool. Once a day it collects the fees the position earned, and every hour it checks the range: when the price has stayed out of it for the wait its own record sets, the agent re-sets a wide range (±{n}, the width set by hand) centred on the price again, with one swap that balances the two tokens. Of what the position earns, a third stays as capital, a third buys $BOBAI that stays in the agent's wallet and a third is paid out to the operator.
